title: SeaPO: Strategic Error Amplification for Robust Preference Optimization of Large Language Models
authors_zh: Jun Rao, Yunjie Liao, Xuebo Liu, Zepeng Lin, Lian Lian, Dong Jin, Shengjun Cheng, Jun Yu, Min Zhang
paper_type_zh: 合成偏好负样本构造研究
best_for_zh: 适合奖励模型排序难以产生明显负例、需要自行设计偏好数据的读者。
one_line: SeaPO creates deliberately more erroneous rejected responses so preference optimization can suppress targeted reasoning, logic, and hallucination errors.
SeaPO 刻意构造错误更明显的被拒回答，使偏好优化能压低指定的推理、逻辑和幻觉错误。
why: It changes the content and severity of negative preference evidence, making the data itself encode the failure modes training should reduce.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly constructs the rejected side of preference records to make optimization target specific recurring error modes rather than weakly separated chosen-rejected pairs.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Preference optimization needs a clear difference between chosen and rejected answers. Rejection sampling and reward-model scoring can create pairs whose two responses are similarly good, making the preference signal weak.

SeaPO asks how to build negative preference evidence that exposes the errors a model should stop making. It changes the rejected response itself rather than relying on a stronger scorer to find one.

偏好优化需要被选回答与被拒回答之间有清晰差异。拒绝采样和奖励模型评分可能得到两个都相近的回答，使偏好信号很弱。

SeaPO 要回答的是，如何构造能暴露模型应停止犯下错误的负向偏好证据。它改变被拒回答本身，而不依赖更强评分器去寻找负例。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SeaPO starts from a positive answer and injects strategic errors into a negative rewrite. The intended negative is deliberately worse than the chosen answer, so the optimization objective receives a more discriminative contrast.

The paper groups target failures into three recurring error types and studies both task-specific and mixed error construction. The negative data therefore encodes what behavior to suppress.

SeaPO 从正向回答出发，在负向改写中注入策略性错误。预期的负例刻意比被选回答更差，使优化目标得到更有区分力的对比。

论文把目标失败分为三类常见错误，并研究任务专用与混合错误构造。负向数据因而编码了应被压低的行为。

title: Method
方法
html:
For a question and positive response, an error-injection model produces a rejected response with a specified error type. The pair is then used in an error-focused preference objective that lowers the probability of the rejected answer.

The design avoids reward-model scoring during pair construction. Experiments vary error type, severity, source model, and mixing strategy to test how those data choices alter downstream preference learning.

对一个问题和正向回答，错误注入模型生成带指定错误类型的被拒回答。随后该对样本进入以错误为中心的偏好目标，降低被拒回答的概率。

该设计在构造样本时避免奖励模型评分。实验改变错误类型、严重程度、来源模型和混合策略，测试这些数据选择如何改变下游偏好学习。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates models from 1.5B to 14B over reasoning, code, knowledge, translation, and truthfulness settings. It reports that its constructed negatives improve overall performance and gives truthfulness gains of five to ten percentage points in the reported comparisons.

Ablations compare error types, mixtures, severity, and objectives. They show that frequent task-relevant errors help related tasks, while mixed errors give broader gains; results still vary with data source and task difficulty.

论文在推理、代码、知识、翻译和真实性设置上评测 1.5B 到 14B 模型。它报告构造的负例提升整体表现，并在所报告的比较中带来 5 到 10 个百分点的真实性提升。

消融比较错误类型、混合、严重度和目标函数。结果表明高频且任务相关的错误有利于相关任务，混合错误带来更广泛收益；结果仍会随数据来源和任务难度变化。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive decision is to synthesize the negative side of a preference pair around known failure patterns. It replaces uncertain “second best” sampling with a controllable error contract.

This makes the preference record an intervention: it states not only which answer wins, but which error mechanism the model should unlearn.

独特决定是围绕已知失败模式合成偏好对的负向一侧。它以可控错误契约替代不确定的“次优”采样。

这让偏好记录成为一种干预：它不仅说明哪个回答胜出，也说明模型应忘掉哪种错误机制。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Injected errors may not represent the failures encountered after deployment, and positive-response quality depends on the source data. Benefits differ by task and error type. The paper does not release code or constructed preference pairs.
注入错误未必代表部署后遇到的失败，正向回答质量依赖源数据。收益随任务和错误类型而异。论文未发布代码或构造的偏好对。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use SeaPO when preference-pair negatives are too weak or expensive to score. It is most useful for a training program with a concrete error taxonomy; audit whether generated negatives are realistic and do not introduce unintended artifacts.
当偏好对负例过弱或评分成本过高时，可使用 SeaPO。它最适合拥有明确错误分类的训练项目；应审计生成负例是否真实，并确认不会引入意外伪影。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the method as data construction for an optimization target. Inspect the chosen source, error taxonomy, severity, and task mix together, because each decides which behavior receives negative probability pressure.
应把该方法视为针对优化目标的数据构造。请一起检查被选来源、错误分类、严重度和任务混合，因为每一项都决定哪些行为会受到负概率压力。
